name: The Corrupter
summary: At Thunder Axe Fortress, a flayed strip from the Burning Blade bears red markings and a signature-like symbol. It smells rotten, yet bends easily. Maurin Bonesplitter at Ghost Walker Post may know more.

sections.title: A Strip of Skin
sections.body: The flayed skin smells of rot, yet bends easily despite its dry, fragile feel. Unrolled, it shows red markings on one side, written in some kind of language. A plain symbol at the bottom looks like a signature.

sections.title: Maurin's View
sections.body: Maurin Bonesplitter at Ghost Walker Post may know more about the skin. Maurin believes the Burning Blade are coming to see how weak they are. Their magic is poor and their strength slight. Whatever power they hold comes from those they serve, not from any grasp of true power or knowledge.

sections.title: What the Markings Mean
sections.body: Maurin recognises the runes as an old language, somewhat like Eredun but very different in its details. If Maurin is right, the skin is a kind of contract. At the bottom, the symbol is the signature of a demon named Lord Azrethoc.

faq.q: What is written on the flayed skin?
faq.answer: Red markings in some kind of written language cover one side of the flayed skin. At the bottom, a clear symbol looks like a signature. Maurin Bonesplitter at Ghost Walker Post may know more.

faq.q: Where does the skin come from?
faq.answer: The skin was taken from the Burning Blade at Thunder Axe Fortress in Desolace.
Maurin Bonesplitter is at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace, where the skin is brought.

faq.q: What does Maurin think of the Burning Blade?
faq.answer: Maurin sees the Burning Blade as weak, with poor magic and little strength. Maurin believes whatever power they have comes from those they serve.
